historical_attempt_note: Initial bare multi-item requests exposed a real missing first-item Received prefix. The worker-clarification experiment still produced generic misunderstood replies and incomplete provider responses, so it remained failed and was stopped. No failure is counted as a pass. The runtime prefix was then fixed, and both exact short multi sentences passed three times per mode with useful first replies and every provider response completed. Original longer multi sentences were also rerun three times per mode.

source_impact.change: Add the already-selected Received prefix to the first item when a multiple-item package list has no leading action. Other paths return the same text as before.
source_impact.unaffected_proof_equivalence: The 96 other supplemental checks passed before this last one-line change. None enters the bare multiple-item branch: found, single-item bags, Setton, SS make, Office handoffs, and missing-ingredient make. Every other runtime source hash is identical. The 12 short-multi final checks and 12 full-sentence main-multi rechecks ran with all final runtime hashes unchanged.
